cross_verification.note_en: The Eswatini Government official visa page (gov.sz) confirms visa applications require 'Two (2) identity photographs' but does not publish exact dimensions, background color, or facial-pose specifications. Eswatini has no fully automated eVisa portal with published photo specs at the time of this research; evisa.gov.sz exists but its landing content did not itself detail photo requirements. Applicants are directed to the Ministry of Home Affairs or an Eswatini embassy/high commission for further detail, which this research could not independently access.
